service: chatbot-modes

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ap-south-1
  httpApi:
    cors: true
  environment:
    DATABASE_URL: ${env:DATABASE_URL}
    GROQ_API_KEY: ${env:GROQ_API_KEY}

functions:
  health:
    handler: handlers/health.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/health
          method: get
  dbtest:
    handler: handlers/dbtest.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/dbtest
          method: get
  llmtest:
    handler: handlers/llmtest.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/llmtest
          method: get
  chat:
    handler: handlers/chat.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/chat
          method: post
  listConversations:
    handler: handlers/listConversations.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/conversations
          method: get
  getMessages:
    handler: handlers/getMessages.handler
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /api/conversations/{id}/messages
          method: get

plugins:
  - serverless-offline
